s10.old: - **Metaloop start failure mode:** `metaloop.ps1 -Action start` failed with `GLASS BOX launch incomplete: 4/5 views healthy`. Cause: a `console.ps1 -Lane <x>` process was alive but its heartbeat had frozen about 10 h earlier. It holds `state\lane-<x>.runtime.lock` with `FileShare::None`, so every newly spawned console hits the `catch [IO.IOException] { exit 0 }` path and dies instantly - the launcher's 10 s health deadline then fails the start.
s10.why: "frozen about 10 h earlier" is time
